name: Hiiragi Renge
source:
The elder sister of the infamous Hiiragi duo, who are known for their martial prowess within the Kurojou-gumi. 

She has served the gang since the previous generation, alongside her younger sister, Sara. 

In battle, Renge is ruthless, tormenting her opponents both physically and mentally, often with a sinister laugh.

Part of Kurojou-gumi
